branches.label: main
branches.description: The long-lived production line. Every commit here is considered deployable and matches a released state.

branches.label: develop
branches.description: The integration line for the next release. Feature branches merge here before a release is cut.

branches.label: feature/*
branches.description: Short-lived branch for a single feature or improvement. Branches from and merges back into develop.

branches.label: release/*
branches.description: Prepared from develop when a release is imminent. Only bug fixes, docs, and release metadata; merged into main and develop.

branches.label: hotfix/*
branches.description: Branches from main to fix a production incident immediately. Merged into both main and develop.
